title: Tentative Bid Ledger
brief: An auction desk tool keeps traders' tentative bids in a last-in, first-out ledger: new bids go on top, and undo removes the most recent one. Traders also want to see the lowest bid currently in the ledger at any moment, and that display refreshes after every action.

Implement the class BidLedger with a constructor taking no arguments and four methods: push(value) adds a bid on top, pop() removes the top bid, top() returns the top bid without removing it, and getMin() returns the smallest bid currently in the ledger.
